checks_passed.check: fidelity - the printed defect in Tables 5 and 6 is recorded, not corrected

None of the atom labels in the Bindung columns of Tables 3 and 4 (Cl(1)-C(3), F(2)-C(10)-F(3), C(9B)-C(10B), O(3A)-C(8)-O(3B) and the rest) is emitted as a compound record. That is the correct direction: they are not compounds.

The only masses in the patent are the 2 g of tembotrione charged in each of the three Examples at lines 661, 668 and 672. All three are carried as mass_g 2.0 on the tembotrione reactant record of their section, with mmol, equivalents and yield_pct null because the patent states none. No volume, no yield and no purity is stated anywhere for any compound, and none is asserted. The application rates at line 644 (1 g to 1 kg per hectare, preferably 5 g to 500 g per ha) are dose rates and are correctly not written into quantity.

There is nothing to close. The three Examples each charge 2 g of tembotrione and report no product mass, no mole amount and no yield; the general process at lines 573 to 588 gives no quantity at all. No mass balance, yield or step to step continuity can be computed, so no validation flag is owed on any record and none is missing. This was checked, not assumed.

I opened input/pages/p02.png and read the drawn formula off the page. The benzene ring carries, going round from the carbon that bears the benzoyl bridge: Cl at position 2, CH2-O-CH2-CF3 at position 3 and SO2CH3 at position 4, and the bridge carbonyl joins position 2 of a cyclohexane-1,3-dione whose C2 is drawn as an sp3 carbon. The SMILES at line 61 encodes exactly that ring system, exactly those three substituents and exactly those three positions, and its C17H16ClF3O6S counts out atom by atom against the printed name at line 48. Nothing here was inferred from chemical knowledge in place of the page. There is no reaction scheme anywhere in this patent, so there is no above the arrow against below the arrow question and no background scheme that could have been annotated as the invention's route.
